string.text: High capacity magazine (40 rounds)
Using a PMAG 40 AR magazine reduces the number of reloads in combat.
High capacity magazine (60 rounds)
Using the SureFire MAG5-60 magazine makes it much easier to fight against a superior number of opponents.
Tactical grip

Replacing the forend and installing a tactical grip increases the convenience of firing a weapon.In addition, the presence of Piccatiny rails on the new forend allows you to install additional tactical modules on the weapon.
Tactical module
The Insight AN/PEQ-16a tactical unit combines the functions of a laser designator and a tactical flashlight.An indispensable thing for fighting at night.
Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Anatomical handle
Provides the right hand with a more comfortable grip.
Bayonet

Installing the L3A1 bayonet on the weapon allows you to use the machine gun as a melee weapon.Due to the design features of the weapon, it is impossible to use a bayonet simultaneously with an under-barrel grenade launcher or silencer.
USM calibration
Individual fitting and balancing of standard parts of the firing mechanism allows for higher shooting accuracy while reducing recoil.
Forcing USM
Refinement of the firing mechanism components makes it possible to increase the weapon's rate of fire, unfortunately, at the cost of some reduction in reliability.
Modification of the cartridge supply unit
Refinement of the ammunition supply unit makes it possible to reduce the number of delays associated with non-feeding and misalignment of the cartridge.
Improved DTK
Installing an improved muzzle compensator can significantly reduce recoil.
Barrel adjustment
Allows you to reduce the spread of bullets, which has a beneficial effect on the accuracy of firing.
Changing the barrel cutting pitch
Increases the initial speed of the bullet, due to which the bullet deviates less from the expected trajectory and reaches the target faster.Useful for long range shooting.
Improved backplate
Installation of an anatomical rubberized butt plate reduces the felt recoil from shots fired by the shooter.
Shutter Balancing
Balancing the bolt group parts reduces the barrel moving away from the line of sight when firing, and also reduces the likelihood of delays when firing.
Heavy Duty Parts
Replacing standard parts with analogues made of high-strength alloys makes it possible to increase the wear resistance of weapons.
Light alloy parts
Replacing standard parts with analogues made of light alloys significantly reduces the weight of the weapon.
Improved fire mode switch
Reduces the likelihood of delays due to malfunctions in the firing mode switching unit.
